errors.text: The proposed Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni-Ti composition omits Mg and V and therefore does not reconstruct the target MgAlTiVFeCo alloy.
The 1200–1300 °C SPS window is incompatible with the target upper limit of 1000 °C, which is imposed to avoid magnesium volatilization.
Oxidation at 800 °C and corrosion in 1 M H2SO4 do not reproduce the target tests at 900 °C in air and in 3.5 wt% NaCl.

The claimed B2+BCC mediator and Cr2O3 protection mechanism replace the target oxide barrier phases AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 and are not directly established for the exact proposed composition and processing window.
